# Hybrid Assembly Benchmark

## Objective

Measure how Illumina and long-read depth affect assembly accuracy and contiguity against a known simulated genome.

```r
library(simitall)

simref <- "results/genome/repeat_stress.fa"
run_grid_both(
  simref_fa = simref,
  tag = "repeat_stress",
  ill_covs = c(20, 40, 60),
  pb_covs = c(10, 20, 30),
  seed = 303
)
run_unicycler_grid("repeat_stress", threads = 8, reads_dir = "reads")
run_quast_grid("repeat_stress", ref_fa = simref, threads = 4,
               assemblies_dir = "assemblies", output_dir = "evaluation")
summarize_quast("evaluation/repeat_stress", "results/summary/repeat_stress.csv")
```

## Important Constraint

For HiFi simulation, verify whether the installed simulator creates final HiFi reads or multi-pass precursors requiring PacBio CCS. Do not label precursor reads as final CCS/HiFi reads.

## Report

Show genome fraction, misassemblies, mismatches, indels, contig count, N50, read-length distribution, actual depth, repeat settings, and a chosen minimum-depth rule.
